selected.titulo: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
selected.resumen: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.
